resources.string: APK backup and restore with honest privilege tiers.
This milestone backs up APK files (+ splits) into a .kilnbackup.zip with metadata.json. App private data under /data/data is not included without Root.
No Shizuku/Root: APK-only archives. Restore installs the base APK via PackageInstaller (system confirm) or silent install when Shizuku is ready.
Shizuku is ready. Android/data + OBB packaging is not wired yet — archives stay APK-only so we never claim data we did not copy.
Root capability seen. Full /data/data backup/restore is not wired yet — archives stay APK-only for now.
Restore queued — confirm the system install dialog if shown
Kiln will extract the base APK from a .kilnbackup.zip and queue an install. Splits and app data are not restored in this milestone. A system confirm may appear.
